blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World-action models (WAMs) build policies on pretrained video-generation models, on the premise that predicting how a scene evolves helps determine how to act. However, generating future scenes is expensive for real-time control. This motivates efficient proxies for future imagination, but how to train such proxies without sacrificing action-prediction quality remains unclear. An effective proxy need not generate a high-resolution frame; it only needs to provide enough information to distinguish between possible futures. This leads to the design principle behind iWAM: rather than denoising an entire future frame, can we condition the action policy on intermediate features from a single video-model evaluation? We show that the answer is yes. Exploiting the reversible dynamics of flow-matching models, we invert each training future into the corresponding latent noise vector. However, a single velocity evaluation at this latent does not necessarily yield informative features for action prediction. We therefore learn a bidirectional flow map that amortizes future-generation computation, enabling a single model evaluation to provide effective conditioning features. At inference, we sample a latent noise vector from the prior and condition the policy using just one video-backbone forward pass. Across simulated benchmarks and real robots, iWAM recovers the generalization benefits of WAMs while substantially reducing its inference cost.
blocks.zh: 世界行动模型(WAMs)将政策建立在预先训练的视频生成模型上,其前提是预测一个场景如何演变有助于决定如何行动. 然而,产生出未来的场景对于实时控制来说是昂贵的. 这激发了未来想象力的有效代理,但如何在不牺牲行动预测质量的情况下训练这种代理仍然不清楚. 有效的代理不需要产生高分辨率的框架;它只需要提供足够的信息来区分可能的后期. 这导致了iWAM背后的设计原则:我们不是去宣布整个未来的框架,而能把行动政策建立在单个视频模型评价的中间特征上吗? 我们显示答案是肯定的。 探索流相匹配模型的可逆动态,我们把每次训练的未来倒入相应的潜在噪声矢量. 然而,在这种潜在情况下进行单一的速度评价不一定为行动预测带来信息性特征。 因此,我们学习了双向流图,将后世计算分期摊还,使单一模型评价能够提供有效的调节功能. 推断一下,我们用一个视频背骨前行通道 从前行和条件中抽取一个潜在的噪声矢量。 通过模拟基准和真机器人,iWAM恢复了WAM的通俗化效益,同时大幅降低了其推论成本.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video generation models have become an attractive source of pretrained priors for robotic manipulation [ 9 , 11 ] . Trained on video data, which is far more abundant than robot data, they learn generalizable priors about objects, spatial relations, and physical dynamics that could help robotic policies generalize beyond limited robot demonstrations. World-action models (WAMs) adapt these models to predict actions by finetuning on robot data. Some jointly predict future video and actions [ 35 , 41 , 2 ] , while others generate future video to condition a separate action network, as in inverse dynamics models (IDMs) [ 5 , 17 ] . During training, IDMs condition the action policy on activations from ground-truth futures; at deployment, these futures must instead be generated. Both approaches benefit from pretrained video priors but incur substantial inference cost from generating full, high-resolution videos, a major obstacle for real-time robotic control. Lighter-weight alternatives such as FastWAM [ 36 ] still train the video model to predict future observations alongside the action policy, but remove future observations from action conditioning entirely. Instead, the policy uses only intermediate features computed from the current observation, substantially reducing inference cost by avoiding future generation.
blocks.zh: 视频生成模型已成为机器人操纵预先训练的前科的有吸引力的来源[9,11]. 视频数据比机器人数据丰富得多,他们通过视频数据培训,了解了物体、空间关系和物理动态等可帮助机器人政策超越有限机器人演示范围的一般前科。 世界动作模型(WAMS)通过微调机器人数据来调整这些模型以预测动作. 一些联合预测未来的视频和行动[35,41,2],而另一些则生成未来的视频以附加单独的动作网络,如反向动态模型[5,17]. 在培训期间,管理和管理部将行动政策作为启动地面真实未来的条件;在部署时,必须创造这些未来。 这两种方法都受益于事先经过培训的视频前科,但产生完整、高分辨率的视频会产生大量推论费用,这是实时机器人控制的一个主要障碍。 FastWAM [36] 等较轻的替代品仍在训练视频模型,以预测未来与动作政策并列的观测,但将未来观测完全从动作条件中删除. 相反,该政策只使用从目前观察中计算出来的中间特征,通过避免后代,大大减少推论成本。

blocks.en: In principle, explicitly generating a future may be unnecessary if the video model’s features already contain enough information about that future for action prediction. Is this possible? What information must these features retain, and how can we obtain it without generating the future itself? Typically, video generation spends test-time compute to progressively transform a sample from the noise prior into a future frame. Our goal is to amortize this computation through training, so that a single forward pass produces features that support accurate action prediction. The challenge is therefore to preserve the useful information obtained through future generation while avoiding the full generation process.
blocks.zh: 原则上,如果视频模型的特性已经包含足够的关于未来的信息,以便进行行动预测,就可能没有必要明确创造未来。 这有可能吗? 这些特征必须保留哪些信息,我们如何在不创造未来的情况下获得这些信息? 通常情况下,视频生成会花费测试时间进行计算,逐渐将一个样本从噪声之前转变为未来的帧. 我们的目标是通过训练来摊还这种计算,这样,单向前传就能产生支持准确动作预测的特性. 因此,面临的挑战是保留通过后代获得的有用信息,同时避免整个一代过程。

blocks.en: Simply omitting that test-time computation does not guarantee that the remaining features contain the information needed to act. Our analysis shows that directly reading out actions from frozen video-backbone features using a FastWAM-style conditioning scheme generalizes poorly out of distribution. For example, when training on LIBERO this prior approach attains a strong in-distribution performance, but fails on perturbations in LIBERO-PRO (Sections 4 and 6 ). These results suggest that access to pretrained features alone is insufficient in this setting: the computation used to construct a possible future may also contribute to generalization. Our aim is to retain the benefits of this computation by learning a shortcut that provides informative future-conditioning features in a single forward pass.
blocks.zh: 略去试验时间的计算并不能保证其余特征包含采取行动所需的信息。 我们的分析显示,使用FastWAM式的调制方案,直接从冷冻的视频背骨功能中读出动作,但一般不能够分发。 例如,在进行关于LIBERO的培训时,这种事先的方法在分配方面表现良好,但在LIBERO-PRO的干扰上失败(第4和第6节)。 这些结果表明,在此情况下,仅获得预先训练过的特性是不够的:用于构建可能的未来的计算也可能有助于概括。 我们的目标是通过学习一条捷径来保留这一计算的好处,这条捷径在一次前传中提供了翔实的的未来调节功能.

blocks.en: To construct this shortcut, we exploit the reversible dynamics of flow-matching models. For a fixed conditioning vector, the underlying continuous flow defines a one-to-one correspondence between a noise vector and the future latent it generates. We can therefore invert any given future, the information an IDM would ordinarily condition on, to recover its corresponding noise. This raises a concrete question: can intermediate features from a single evaluation at this noise endpoint provide useful future conditioning without reconstructing the future itself? Reversibility alone does not guarantee this. A standard flow model predicts instantaneous velocities, and the corresponding future is obtained by integrating these velocities along the generative trajectory. Features from a single velocity evaluation need not capture the information that becomes accessible through this iterative generation process.
blocks.zh: 为了构建这个捷径,我们利用了流配模型的可逆动态. 对于固定调节矢量,基础连续流定义了噪音矢量与它产生的未来潜伏物之间的一对一对应. 因此,我们可以颠倒任何特定的未来,一个IDM通常会附加的信息,以恢复其相应的噪音。 这提出了一个具体问题:在这个噪音端点的单一评价中的中间特征能否提供有用的未来条件而不重建未来本身? 仅靠逆转并不能保证这一点。 一个标准流模型预测瞬时速度,而相应的未来是通过将这些速度与基因轨迹结合而获得的. 单一速度评价的特征不需要捕捉通过这种迭代生成过程可以获取的信息.

blocks.en: To make this correspondence useful, we propose i WAM , which learns a bidirectional flow map on robot data. Motivated by prior work on amortizing flow-matching processes [ 3 , 8 , 7 ] , this model approximates the average velocity of standard flow-matching over finite time intervals in both directions. This quantity summarizes the transformation along a trajectory segment, allowing the model to learn a shortcut to the computation required for future generation. We condition the action policy on intermediate features from a single evaluation of this bidirectional model. During training, we integrate each demonstrated future in the clean-to-noise direction to recover its noise endpoint, then extract features from one evaluation at that endpoint. This aligns the policy’s conditioning features with the future corresponding to its supervising actions, and allows us to effectively fit the action expert. At inference, we sample an endpoint from the noise prior and extract features in the same way. The action policy combines these activations with features from past observations, requiring only one video-backbone evaluation for future conditioning.
blocks.zh: 为了让这些通信有用,我们提议i WAM, 学习机器人数据上的双向流图。 这一模式的动机是先前关于流动匹配过程的摊销[3、8、7]的工作,它大致反映了标准流动匹配在两个方向的有限时间间隔上的平均速度。 这一数量总结了沿轨迹段的变换,使模型能够学习到未来世代所需的计算捷径. 我们通过对这一双向模式的单一评价,将行动政策设定为中间特征。 在训练期间,我们把每一个显示的未来都纳入到清洁到噪音的方向中,以恢复其噪音终点,然后从该终点的一个评价中提取特征。 这使得政策的条件性特征与与其监督行动相应的未来相一致,使我们能够有效地适应行动专家。 推论,我们从噪音中抽取一个端点,然后以同样的方式提取特征. 行动政策将这些激活与过去观测的特征结合起来,只需要一次视频背骨评估就可以进行未来调节.

blocks.en: Across simulated and real-world manipulation benchmarks [ 40 , 13 , 12 ] , i WAM recovers the generalization benefits of explicitly future-conditioned policies at the inference cost nearing that of approaches that discard future generation entirely. This clarifies what an action policy requires from a video model to generalize: neither a highly precise future nor observation-conditioned activations that leave the future unresolved, but sufficient information to identify the relevant mode of the future-video distribution . Explicit future generation is sufficient to specify such a mode; the success of iWAM shows that it is not necessary.
blocks.zh: 通过模拟和实际世界操纵基准[40、13、12],i WAM恢复了明确的未来条件政策的一般化好处,其推论代价接近完全抛弃后代的方法。 这澄清了一种行动政策从一个视频模型到概括的要求:无论是高度精确的未来,还是使未来问题得不到解决的观察条件下的激活,都不足以确定未来视频分发的相关模式。 明晰的后代足以指定这种模式;iWAM的成功表明没有必要.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Video generation models for robot control. Video models pretrained on large video datasets capture how objects and scenes evolve, providing a useful prior for robot control [ 9 , 11 ] . World-action models (WAMs) adapt this prior by finetuning on robot data and predicting actions from imagined futures [ 5 , 19 , 41 , 2 , 17 , 35 , 14 ] . WAMs show promising generalization to unseen objects, scenes, and tasks, but repeatedly evaluating a large video backbone to generate futures makes inference slow. Our goal is to retain the benefits of conditioning on imagined futures without iterative generation.
blocks.zh: 机器人控制的视频生成模型. 视频模型预先在大型视频数据集上训练,可以捕捉物体和场景的演化方式,为机器人控制提供有用的前置[9,11]. 世界行动模型(WAMs)先通过微调机器人数据和预测来自想象中的未来的动作来适应这个过程[5,19,41,2,17,35,14]. WAM显示对看不见的物体,场景,和任务有希望的概括,但反复评价一个大型的视频骨干以产生未来,使得推论缓慢. 我们的目标是在不发生迭代的情况下,保留以想象的未来为条件的好处。

blocks.en: Efficient action prediction from video models. Several methods avoid generating the future at inference. FastWAM [ 36 ] and UVA [ 18 ] train the video model to predict the future alongside actions, but at test time predict actions from representations of the current observation alone. VPP [ 10 ] and VidMan [ 34 ] condition the action policy on intermediate features from a single forward pass of a video diffusion model, rather than on a generated video. We argue that such approaches are limited: their features are computed either from the current observation alone or from independently sampled noise, so during training they need not correspond to the future whose actions supervise the policy. In Section 4 , we show that removing the future from the conditioning hurts generalization to unseen environments, and in Section 5 , we show that conditioning on independently sampled noise fits diverse data such as DROID poorly. i WAM also uses a single forward pass of the video backbone, but during training its activations correspond to the same future as the demonstrated actions.
blocks.zh: 视频模型的高效动作预测. 几种方法避免推论产生未来。 FastWAM [36]和UVA [18] 训练视频模型,以预测未来与动作并列,但在测试时仅从当前观测的表述中预测动作. VPP [10]和Vidman [34] 将动作政策以中间特性作为条件,从视频传播模型的单个前传,而不是以生成的视频. 我们认为,这种办法是有限的:其特征是仅从目前的观察或从独立抽样的噪音中计算出来的,因此,在培训期间,它们不需要与未来相对应,后者的行动监督政策。 在第四节中,我们显示,把未来从条件中移除会伤害到通俗化到看不见的环境,在第五节中,我们显示,对独立取样的噪音的调制与DROID等不同数据不匹配。 iWAM也使用视频主干线的单向前传,但在训练期间其激活对应与演示动作相同的未来.

blocks.en: Few-step and bidirectional flow maps. A large body of work reduces the cost of sampling from diffusion and flow models by learning to traverse the probability flow in a few large steps, including consistency models [ 32 ] , shortcut models [ 7 ] , MeanFlow [ 8 ] , terminal velocity matching [ 39 ] , and flow maps more generally [ 3 ] . The flow can also be run in reverse to recover the noise that generates a given sample: DDIM inversion [ 31 ] does so by integrating backward in many steps, and bidirectional consistency models [ 16 ] learn to do so in a few. These methods aim to generate or edit samples more cheaply. We use a bidirectional flow map for a different purpose, and never decode the future at all: during training, the clean-to-noise direction recovers the noise endpoint of the demonstrated future, and the noise-to-clean direction provides, in a single evaluation, the activations on which the action policy is conditioned.
blocks.zh: 少步双向流图. 大量的工作通过学习在几大步中穿越概率流,包括一致性模型[32],捷径模型[7],MeanFlow [8],终端速度匹配[39],以及更一般的流图[3],降低了从扩散和流模型中取样的成本. 流量也可以逆向运行以恢复产生特定样本的噪声: DDIM反演[31]通过将后向整合到许多步骤中来实现,双向一致性模型[16]在少数环节学习实现. 这些方法旨在更便宜地生成或编辑样本. 我们用双向流图来达到不同的目的,永远不解码未来:在训练中,清扫到噪声方向恢复了所显示的未来的噪声终点,噪声到噪声方向在一次评价中提供了行动政策所依赖的激活.

Unlike the marginal velocity in flow matching, the average velocity describes the displacement over the entire interval from t t to s s . A flow map can therefore move directly between distant points along the flow without integrating the marginal velocity field over many intermediate steps. We consider flow maps defined over arbitrary time pairs t , s ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] t,s\in[0,1] , allowing both noise-to-clean ( s < t s<t ) and clean-to-noise ( s > t s>t ) transport, and refer to this as a bidirectional flow map .
Flow maps can be trained with several self-distillation objectives [ 3 ] . Methods such as MeanFlow [ 8 ] and TVM [ 39 ] achieve state-of-the-art one-step image generation, but require network derivatives, which are costly and can destabilize training at video scale. We instead use shortcut-style model training [ 7 ] , which is related to Salimans and Ho [28] and bootstraps larger steps from compositions of smaller ones using only forward evaluations of the network.

blocks.en: Setup. We compare FastWAM and IDM in two settings, training a separate set of models for each. In both, the two methods share the same Wan2.2-5B video backbone [ 33 ] and 1B-parameter action expert. In our main setting, we train on DROID [ 13 ] , a large and diverse dataset of real-world manipulation demonstrations, and evaluate the resulting policies in environments not seen during training: three pick-and-place tasks in the DROID simulation benchmark [ 12 ] , and three real-world tasks on a physical robot. In the second setting, we train on LIBERO [ 22 ] and evaluate on LIBERO-PRO [ 40 ] , which tests the policies under controlled perturbations to objects, initial states, and instructions. As such, the LIBERO benchmark alone is too saturated to be able to meaningfully differentiate the performance of various methods. Full training and evaluation details are provided in Section 6 .

blocks.en: Findings. On DROID, removing future conditioning substantially hurts performance. In simulation (Table 2 ), FastWAM succeeds in 9.2% of trials, compared to 96.7% for IDM, and fails entirely on two of the three tasks. The gap persists on real robots: FastWAM averages 13.3% success against 80.0% for IDM. On Blocks → \rightarrow Bowl, FastWAM places at least one block in 80% of trials but never completes all three placements, whereas IDM does so in 85% of trials (per-horizon and per-placement results are reported in Tables 6 and 5 ). Qualitative rollouts also reveal failures in FastWAM’s instruction following: it manipulates objects unrelated to the instructed task or abandons the target object after a missed grasp (see Figure 10 ). These failures occur despite the base video model’s ability to generalize to these same unseen environments and accurately predict plausible futures, as also reflected in IDM’s strong performance using these predictions. This gap suggests that FastWAM’s action policy does not fully exploit the generalizable priors available in the pretrained video model, which IDM is able to utilize.
blocks.zh: 发现。 在DROID上,移除未来调节会严重伤害性能. 在模拟(表2)中,FastWAM成功完成9.2%的试验,而IDM成功96.7%,完全失败于三项任务中的两项. 真正的机器人上的差距仍然存在:FastWAM平均成功率为13.3%,而IDM成功率为80.0%. FastWAM在80%的审判中至少设置了一个街区,但从未完成所有三项安置,而在85%的审判中,IDM做到了这一点(每场和每场安置结果见表6和表5)。 定性推出还揭示了FastWAM以下指令中的失败:它操纵与指示任务无关的对象,或者在丢失了抓取后放弃目标对象(见图10). 尽管基底视频模型能够概括到同样看不见的环境并准确预测可能的未来,但是这些失败还是会发生,这一点也反映在IDM使用这些预测的强效表现上. 这一差距表明,FastWAM的行动政策没有充分利用预先培训的视频模型中普遍存在的前科,而IDM能够利用这一模型。

blocks.en: On LIBERO-PRO, the gap is smaller but consistent (Table 3 ): averaged over the four perturbation types, IDM succeeds in 51.6% of trials against 44.5% for FastWAM with joint training, and 54.4% against 51.3% with two-stage training. Additional LIBERO-PRO results, including the effect of joint versus two-stage training, are provided in Appendix B . Figure 1 shows that FastWAM falls further behind IDM as evaluation shifts to unseen scenes and tasks. The relative gap grows from 0.9% in-distribution to 6.0% in mean OOD success with two-stage training, and from 1.0% to 16.0% with joint training. These results suggest that conditioning on features obtained from the current observation, as in FastWAM, may suffice when evaluation closely matches the training distribution, but becomes limiting on diverse data and in unseen environments, where features from an imagined future generalize better by drawing on the video model’s large-scale pretraining. Next, we will build a simple mental model to understand this finding, which in turn will motivate a simple approach to address this issue.

blocks.zh: 5i WAM:没有未来预测的高效WAM

blocks.en: The results above comparing FastWAM and IDM suggest a pattern similar to that observed in language models [ 30 , 29 ] : policies generalize better when we spend test-time compute generating future imaginations, as in IDM, but these gains disappear when we omit this process, as in FastWAM. In particular, not spending test-time compute appears most harmful in scenarios that demand generalization [ 29 ] , analogous to how a language model that only reasons with short chain-of-thought can have high in-distribution performance but may not generalize to slight perturbations of problems [ 23 , 1 ] . The natural next question is whether we can retain these generalization benefits without paying the full computational cost. At first glance, this may appear to require a “free lunch”: if these benefits arise from spending substantial test-time compute generating a future, replacing this process with a single model evaluation might inevitably discard useful information. However, we also note that action prediction as such should not require reconstructing the full high-resolution future in principle, as long as we can extract a sufficiently informative proxy for it. This suggests a different possibility: we can amortize enough of the generation process into a learned model to expose the information relevant for action prediction.
blocks.zh: 以上对FastWAM和IDM的比较结果表明一种类似于语言模型[30,29]中观察到的模式:当我们像在IDM那样花费测试时间计算出未来想象时,政策更加概括化,但当我们忽略了这一过程时,这些收益就消失了,如在FastWAM中。 特别是,在要求概括化的情景中,不使用测试时间计算似乎最有害,这类似于一种语言模式,即只有思想链短的原因才能具有高分布性能,但不能概括为对问题的轻微干扰[23,1]。 下一个自然的问题是,我们是否能够保留这些一般化福利,而不支付全部计算费用。 乍一看,这似乎需要“免费午餐”:如果这些好处来自花费大量试验时间计算产生未来,那么以单一的模型评价取代这一过程就可能不可避免地丢弃有用的信息。 然而,我们还注意到,行动预测本身不应要求原则上重建全面高分辨率的未来,只要我们能够为此提取一个足够翔实的代词。 这表明一种不同的可能性:我们可以将生成过程的足够分期摊还到一个学习到的模型中,以暴露出与行动预测相关的信息.

A natural starting point is to ask whether adding a small amount of test-time compute to FastWAM-style approaches can improve generalization. One straightforward option is to take one or a few integration steps along the video model’s generative flow. At inference, running this process to completion yields exactly the generated future that IDM conditions on, which generalizes well in our experiments. This means that conditioning on features from a few integration steps could provide for a reasonable proxy for action prediction. Concretely, we consider conditioning the action expert on intermediate features from a single video-backbone evaluation, instead of the many evaluations required to generate a future through standard flow matching. The simplest instantiation of this idea is as follows: for each training example ( c , o 1 , a 1 ) (c,o_{1},a_{1}) , sample a noise endpoint z 1 ∼ p prior z_{1}\sim p_{\mathrm{prior}} from the noise prior distribution of the flow-matching model, evaluate the velocity field once at z 1 z_{1} , and train the action expert to predict the demonstrated actions a 1 a_{1} from features of the video model produced during this one forward pass to compute the velocity field. We refer to this variant as 1-Step from Prior .
However, this approach fits the training data poorly: as shown in Figure 2 , it reaches a substantially higher action-training loss than IDM, even though both use the same amount of test-time compute during training. Why?

blocks.en: The difficulty is that a single evaluation of a standard flow model does not necessarily reveal features that uniquely direct towards the future imagination associated with the sampled noise endpoint. Under the full integrated flow, each z 1 z_{1} deterministically maps to a particular clean future. Recovering that future, however, requires integrating the learned vector field over many steps. A standard flow-matching objective does not directly train a single evaluation to expose the future associated with a noise endpoint. In particular, the optimal one-step denoised estimate for standard flow-matching collapses to the conditional mean (see a theoretical argument in Proposition A.1 ). Thus, the compute spent on this single evaluation starting from a noise endpoint cannot necessarily serve as useful test-time compute for action selection.
blocks.zh: 困难在于,对标准流模式的单一评价并不一定揭示出与抽样噪声端点相关联的独特直接面向未来想象的特征. 在完全一体化的流下,每个z 1 z_{1 } 决定性地绘制到特定干净的未来. 然而,要恢复这一未来,需要在许多步骤上整合所学的矢量领域。 一个标准的流量匹配目标并不直接训练一个单一的评价来暴露与噪音端点相关的未来. 特别是,标准流量匹配崩溃与条件平均值的最佳一步解析估计(见A.1提案中的理论论据)。 因此,从噪音端点开始进行这一单一评价的计算不一定能作为选择行动的有用测试时间计算。

blocks.en: Main Challenge: A Single Flow Evaluation Underutilizes Test-Time Compute A single flow-model evaluation consumes test-time compute without resolving a specific future, limiting its utility for action prediction.
blocks.zh: 主要挑战: 单一流程评价 测试时间计算 单一的流程模型评价消耗测试时间计算而不解决具体的未来,限制了其对行动预测的效用.

blocks.en: A natural conclusion from the preceding argument is that amortizing the computation from multiple flow-model evaluations into a single evaluation could address this limitation. Our method in the next section will in fact build on this idea and learn “shortcut” models to amortize test-time compute. But is amortization alone sufficient? If the difficulty stems only from omitting the test-time compute and amortization will address it, then conditioning on a fully generated future should improve the fit in Figure 2 . We test this by sampling a noise endpoint z 1 z_{1} , fully integrating the flow, and conditioning the action policy on activations computed from the resulting future. During training, this differs from IDM only in using a sampled future in place of the actual future appearing in the data. Yet its training-loss curve remains close to that of the prior-noise variant and substantially above IDM’s. Thus, even completing the full generation process does not resolve the fitting problem.
blocks.zh: 从上述论点得出的一个自然结论是,将从多个流程模型评价中的计算分期摊还为单一评价,可以解决这一局限性。 下一节中我们的方法实际上将基于这一想法,并学习“缩短”模式,以摊还试验时间计算。 但仅靠摊还就够了吗? 如果困难只来自省略测试时间计算和摊销,就会解决,那么,对一个完全生成的未来的调节就应该改善图2中的配位性。 我们通过取样一个 z 1 z_{1}的噪音端点来测试它, 完全整合流量, 并调节关于激活的动作政策 从未来计算。 在培训期间,只有在使用一个抽样的未来来取代数据中出现的实际未来时,这一点才与IDM不同。 然而,其培训损失曲线仍然接近于先前的噪音变体,而且大大高于国际数据交换机制。 因此,即使完成整个生成过程也不能解决适当的问题。

blocks.en: This gap points to a second requirement: to make effective use of amortized test-time compute, we also need alignment between the conditioning future and the actions used for supervision. Each demonstration pairs a realized future o 1 o_{1} with the actions a 1 a_{1} that produce it, so the representation supplied to the action policy should correspond to that same future. An independently sampled z 1 z_{1} need not satisfy this requirement: under the full flow, it may correspond to a different plausible future requiring different actions. The action policy would then receive conditioning that represents one future while being supervised with actions that realize another. To avoid this mismatch, we need the noise endpoint that the flow maps to the demonstrated future o 1 o_{1} . Fortunately, the integrated flow is invertible [ 3 , 21 ] , so we can recover this endpoint with a standard flow model by integrating its velocity field in the clean-to-noise direction. However, this inversion still requires multiple model evaluations. It therefore introduces substantial computational cost during training, even though it is not required at test time.
blocks.zh: 这一差距指出了第二项要求:为了有效地使用摊销的测试时间计算,我们还需要在条件未来和用于监督的行动之间取得一致。 每个示范项目将实现的未来o 1 o o o o _{1}与产生它的行动 o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o = o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o 独立取样的z 1 z _{1}不需要满足这一要求:在全流量下,它可能符合不同的可能的未来,需要不同的行动。 然后,行动政策将获得代表一个未来的条件,同时通过实现另一个未来的行动加以监督。 为了避免这种不匹配,我们需要噪声端点,即流图到显示的未来o 1o_{1}。 幸运的是,集成的流量是不可逆的[3,21],这样我们就可以通过将其速度场整合到清洁到噪声方向,以标准流量模型来恢复这个端点. 然而,这种反演仍需要多种模式评价。 因此,它引入了培训期间的大量计算费用,尽管在测试时不需要。

For efficient action prediction, we need to amortize noise-to-clean computation into a single model evaluation that provides information about the corresponding future. We accomplish both by learning a bidirectional flow map that directly predicts transport between arbitrary flow times in either direction.

blocks.en: 5.4 Implementing i WAM in Practice
blocks.zh: 5.4 在实践中实施i WAM

blocks.en: To learn the flow map, we adopt shortcut-style training [ 7 ] , which exploits the self-consistency property that a flow map over a given time interval is equivalent to the composition of flow maps over smaller subintervals. This enables bootstrapping predictions over longer intervals from shorter ones using only forward evaluations of the network. Intuitively, the bootstrap loss trains the model to approximate the result of two consecutive smaller transport steps with a single larger step, enabling transport between distant flow times in one model evaluation. Although shortcut-style objectives can yield lower one-step sample quality than derivative-based alternatives [ 8 , 3 ] , they provide stable training when predicting many frames jointly, and i WAM requires features that can guide action prediction, rather than high-fidelity generations. Unlike the original shortcut formulation, we train over arbitrary time pairs ( t , s ) (t,s) , enabling both the clean-to-noise and noise-to-clean transport. We train i WAM in two stages: 1) learning this bidirectional flow map and 2) learning an action expert on top of the flow map.
blocks.zh: 为了学习流图,我们采用捷径式的训练[7],它利用了自相容性属性,即在特定时间间隔内的流图相当于在较小的子间隙上的流图组成. 这使得人们能够利用对网络的前期评价,从较短的间隔中作出较长的预测。 从直觉上,靴子丢失对模型进行训练,以近似于连续两个较小的运输步骤的结果,一个较大的步骤,使得在一个模型评价中可以在遥远的流量时间之间进行运输. 虽然捷径式的目标可以产生比衍生型替代品[8,3]更低的单步样本质量,但它们在联合预测许多帧时提供稳定的训练,i WAM需要能够指导动作预测的特性,而不是高纯度的世代. 与最初的捷径配方不同,我们通过任意的时间对(t,s)(t,s)进行训练,既能实现清噪音,又能实现噪声到清洁的运输. 我们分两个阶段训练我WAM: 1)学习此双向流图和2)在流图上学习动作专家.

blocks.en: Prompt guidance. Prompt guidance is important for video generation to generalize to unseen tasks and environments, and IDM-style approaches typically use classifier-free guidance (CFG). However, CFG combines two model evaluations to construct the guided field (Appendix A ); neither evaluation directly provides the guided intermediate activations that i WAM requires. Following Guidance-Free Training (GFT) [ 4 ] , we instead condition the flow map on guidance strength w w and train it to predict the prompt-guided average velocity in a single evaluation. We use similar guidance strengths during action-policy training and inference to keep the guidance used for feature conditioning consistent.

Experimental setup. We evaluate on DROID [ 13 ] and LIBERO-PRO [ 40 ] to study generalization in diverse manipulation environments and under controlled distribution shifts.
DROID is a large-scale, real-world manipulation dataset containing 95K trajectories collected across 564 scenes using a Franka Panda arm with a Robotiq gripper. It captures similar manipulation behaviors across different objects, environments, and operators. We evaluate DROID-trained policies on three simulated pick-and-place tasks and three physical-robot tasks in environments not seen during training.
LIBERO-PRO evaluates policies trained on LIBERO [ 22 ] , which comprises four 10-task suites covering spatial relationships, object variation, task goals, and long-horizon manipulation. It tests generalization through perturbations to object attributes, initial object positions, instruction phrasing, and task intent.
We train a separate set of policies on each dataset, using the same pretrained Wan2.2-5B video backbone and 1B-parameter action expert for all WAMs. DROID policies use the filtered training data described in Appendix C.1 ; LIBERO policies are trained on the original demonstrations and evaluated on LIBERO-PRO without further finetuning. Full training and evaluation details are provided in Appendices B and C.1 .

blocks.en: 3) When does training-time alignment with the demonstrated future matter most? Our results support the requirements identified in Section 5 : exposing future-specific information with a single model evaluation, and aligning that information with demonstrated actions during training. On LIBERO-PRO, the 1-Step from Prior variant matches IDM and improves over FastWAM (Table 5 ). This suggests that a single evaluation can provide useful predictive information even without explicitly matching the noise endpoint to the demonstration. The DROID results show the limits of this approach. Prior-noise conditioning yields substantially higher action-training loss and negligible task success (less than 3% average success in DROID simulation), suggesting that access to predictive information alone is insufficient.
blocks.zh: (3) 培训时间与所显示的未来关系何时最为一致? 我们的成果支持第5节确定的要求:以单一模式评价披露未来特定信息,并使这些信息与培训期间的明显行动相一致。 在LIBERO-PRO上,来自Porce变体的1-步骤与IDM匹配,并且比FastWAM改进(表5). 这表明,单项评价即使没有明确将噪声端点与演示相匹配,也能提供有用的预测信息. DROID的结果表明这一方法的局限性。 事先的噪声条件导致行动培训损失大得多,任务成功率微不足道(在DROID模拟中平均成功率不到3%),这表明仅获取预测信息是不够的。

blocks.en: We attribute this difference to two factors. First, the more realistic DROID dataset exhibits substantially greater diversity in its demonstrated futures than LIBERO. The MSE between futures generated from randomly sampled noise and demonstrated futures is over 10 × 10\times higher on DROID than on LIBERO (Appendix C.2 ). Thus, LIBERO’s more constrained task and demonstration distribution make randomly sampled futures more consistent with demonstrations, leaving limited additional benefit from inversion. Second, DROID presents a substantially larger evaluation shift. LIBERO-PRO applies controlled perturbations to training scenes, whereas our DROID evaluations take place in environments entirely unseen during training. As shown in Section 4 , FastWAM remains relatively close to IDM under the former but falls far behind under the latter. This suggests that the limitations of policies that do not effectively leverage future conditioning become more pronounced under larger distribution shifts. Together, these observations suggest that alignment and future-specific conditioning are particularly important when demonstrations are diverse and evaluation conditions differ substantially from training.
blocks.zh: 我们将此差异归因于两个因素。 首先,更为现实的DROID数据集显示其展示的未来比LIBERO多得多。 随机抽样的噪声产生的期货和显示的期货之间的MSE在DROID上比LiBERO(Appendix C.2 )高10×10\时. 因此,LIBERO更受限制的任务和演示分布使得随机抽样的期货更符合演示,使得反演带来的额外利益有限. 第二,DROID是一个大得多的评价转变。 LIBERO-PRO对训练场景采用有控制的干扰,而我们的DROID评价是在训练期间完全看不见的环境中进行的。 如第4节所示,FastWAM与IDM相对接近,但远远落后于后者。 这表明,在更大的分配转移中,不能有效地利用未来条件的政策的局限性变得更加明显。 这些意见合在一起表明,当示威活动多种多样,评价条件与培训大不相同时,调整和具体的未来条件尤其重要。

blocks.en: In these settings, the bidirectional flow map provides the required alignment during training by approximately recovering the noise endpoint associated with the demonstrated future. A single noise-to-clean evaluation at this endpoint supplies activations that represent the same future as the action supervision, which makes the correspondence between conditioning and actions easier to learn. The reduction in training loss toward IDM’s loss (Figure 2 ), together with the recovery in task success, supports this explanation. i WAM ’s competitive performance further suggests that these activations retain the future-specific information needed for action prediction without requiring an accurate reconstruction of the full future.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和今后的工作

blocks.en: We presented i WAM , which conditions an action policy on the intermediate features of a single video-model forward pass rather than an explicitly generated future. Our approach builds on a simple observation: uniquely identifying an action from a video model’s features of the current observation requires explicit test-time compute. We show that this is one of the reasons why methods that do not spend any test-time compute (e.g., FastWAM) fail to generalize. However, by design, standard flow-matching models underutilize test-time compute when restricted to a single video-model evaluation. To address this, we trained a bidirectional flow map and used a single forward pass through it to predict actions. Across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, i WAM matches the performance of world action models that explicitly generate the future at a fraction of their inference cost, while substantially outperforming methods that condition only on the current observation. These results suggest that policies can benefit from the ability to imagine the full future without paying the cost of generating it.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了i WAM, 以一个视频模式的中间特性作为行动政策的条件, 我们的方法基于一个简单的观察:从目前观察的视频模型的特点中专门确定一个动作需要明确的测试时间计算。 我们显示,这是不花任何试验时间计算的方法(如FastWAM)未能概括的原因之一. 然而,通过设计,标准流程匹配模型在限定于单一视频模型评价时,未充分利用测试时间计算. 为了解决这个问题,我们训练了一个双向流图,并用一个单一的前进通过它来预测行动. 在整个模拟和现实世界的操纵任务中,iWAM与世界行动模型的性能相匹配,这些模型以它们推论成本的一小部分明确产生未来,而其性能却大大超过仅以当前观测为条件的方法. 这些结果表明,政策可以受益于能够想象整个未来而不支付创造未来的费用。

blocks.en: The ideas behind i WAM could also make model-based planning more efficient. Planners built on video models typically generate candidate futures explicitly and score each one with a value function [ 14 ] . Analogous to our action policy, the value function could instead be conditioned on intermediate activations from a single noise-to-clean evaluation of the bidirectional flow map at a sampled noise endpoint, without generating the corresponding future. As in policy training, alignment would remain necessary: a clean-to-noise evaluation would recover the noise endpoint associated with each demonstrated future, so that the conditioning represents the same future as the value target used for supervision. Finally, rather than training a separate value network, the bidirectional flow map itself could be trained to predict the value jointly with the average velocity. This would enable efficient best-of- N N planning: sampling N N noise endpoints, scoring each with a single model evaluation in parallel, and selecting the highest-value candidate without explicitly generating any futures.
blocks.zh: i WAM背后的想法还可以提高基于模型的规划效率. 以视频模型为基础的规划者通常会明确产生候选期货,并给每个具有价值功能的期货打分[14]. 与我们的行动政策相似的是,价值函数可以附加条件,从一个抽样噪声端点对双向流图进行单一噪声至清洁评价的中间激活,而不产生相应的未来。 与政策培训一样,调整仍有必要:清理到噪声的评价将恢复与每个已显示的未来有关的噪音终点,从而使条件代表着与用于监督的价值目标相同的未来。 最后,不培训单独的价值网络,可以培训双向流动图本身,以便结合平均速度来预测价值。 这将有利于有效的N最佳N规划:取样N噪声端点,以一个单一的模型评价对每个点进行平行的评分,在没有明确产生任何未来的情况下选择最高价值的候选人.

blocks.en: Another promising direction is to strengthen the bidirectional flow map with more advanced distillation objectives. Despite using a relatively simple shortcut-style objective, i WAM already nearly matches IDM, leaving only a very small performance gap. We adopted shortcut-style training because it is simple, stable when predicting many frames jointly, and avoids computing network derivatives. The small remaining gap likely reflects approximation error in the learned flow map, suggesting that stronger distillation objectives could close it entirely. Recent distillation methods such as rCM [ 38 ] and its causal variant [ 37 ] achieve high-fidelity few-step video generation at scale and are natural candidates. These objectives could be complemented with an auxiliary adversarial loss, as in One-Forcing [ 6 ] , potentially using the bidirectionally attentive video discriminator of AAD-1 [ 15 ] . Any such objective would need to be extended to both transport directions, since i WAM also relies on the clean-to-noise direction to recover noise endpoints aligned with demonstrated futures.
blocks.zh: 另一个有希望的方向是用更先进的蒸馏目标加强双向流图. 尽管采用了相对简单的快捷键式目标,iWAM已经接近IDM,只留下很小的性能差距. 我们采用了捷径式的训练,因为它在联合预测许多帧时简单,稳定,并避免计算网络衍生物. 残存的小缺口可能反映了所学流程图的近似误差,表明更强的蒸馏目标可以完全关闭. 最近的蒸馏方法如rCM[38]及其因果变体[37]在规模上实现了高精度的几步视频生成,是自然候选. 这些目标可以用辅助性对抗性损失作为补充,例如在One-Forcing [6]中,有可能使用AAD-1[15]的双向专注视频歧视者。 任何此类目标都需要扩展到两个运输方向,因为i WAM还依赖于清洁到噪音方向来回收与已显示的未来相一致的噪音端点.

blocks.en: Shortcut models. Shortcut Models [ 7 ] learn to transport samples between distant flow times by conditioning on flow time and step size, thereby supporting variable sampling budgets. They can be viewed as a progressive self-distillation scheme, where flow matching provides supervision for infinitesimal steps and larger steps are bootstrapped from smaller ones [ 3 ] . Existing shortcut model formulations, however, focus on noise-to-clean transport and do not provide the reverse clean-to-noise mapping needed to associate a clean sample with its noise endpoint. Moreover, Shortcut Models report that standard CFG becomes unreliable for large steps and requires the guidance scale to be specified during training. In our work, we will extend this formulation to arbitrary two-time transport and directly learned guided velocities, enabling bidirectional transport and arbitrary guidance strengths in the single-step regime.

blocks.en: B.1 Evaluation on LIBERO-PRO.
blocks.zh: B.1 对LIBERO-PRO的评价。

blocks.en: As in Section 4 , we train all models only on the original LIBERO demonstrations and evaluate them zero-shot, without further fine-tuning, on both the unperturbed tasks and the four LIBERO-PRO perturbation types defined in Table 7 . For each suite and evaluation condition, we run 50 trials for each of the 10 tasks using the benchmark’s fixed initial states, yielding 500 trials per table entry. The Average columns aggregate results across the four suites, corresponding to 2,000 trials per evaluation condition. Following Yuan et al. [36] , we use a batch size of 128 and train all models for 10 epochs. For two-stage variants, both the video model and the action policy are trained for 10 epochs each. At evaluation, we likewise adopt FastWAM’s inference configuration and apply it identically across all methods.
blocks.zh: 与第4节一样,我们只就最初的LIBERO演示进行所有模型的培训,并在没有进一步微调的情况下,对表7界定的未扰动任务和4种LIBERO-PRO扰动类型进行评估。 对于每个套房和评价条件,我们利用基准的固定初始状态,为10项任务中的每一项进行50项试验,每个表项进行500项试验。 四个套间的平均列总结果相当于每个评价条件的2 000次试验。 继袁等[36],采用批量尺寸128人,为10个纪元训练所有型号. 对于两个阶段的变体,视频模型和行动政策都经过培训,每阶段10个世纪。 在评价时,我们同样采用FastWAM的推论配置,并同样适用于所有方法。

blocks.en: The original FastWAM implementation [ 36 ] jointly trains the action policy and the video model, allowing gradients from the action loss to update the pretrained video model. Due to the narrow action-training data distribution of LIBERO, we find that this can substantially degrade the generalization performance inherited from video pretraining. We adapt the two-stage training strategy of Liang et al. [20] to FastWAM and IDM, where we first fine-tune the video model independently, then freeze its parameters while training the action policy. This substantially improves FastWAM and IDM’s performance across perturbations. However, even with this training strategy, across perturbation categories (see Table 7 ), we find that FastWAM exhibits significantly worse generalization performance than IDM. In addition, we consider the simplified 1-Step from Prior variant, which samples z 1 ∼ p prior z_{1}\sim p_{\mathrm{prior}} independently during training rather than using the noise endpoint associated with the demonstrated future, while using the same Stage 1 video backbone.
blocks.zh: 最初的FastWAM执行[36]联合训练动作政策和视频模型,使得动作损失的梯度可以更新预训视频模型. 由于LIBERO的动作训练数据分布范围狭窄,我们发现这可以大大降低从视频预训中继承的通用性能. 将梁某等人的两阶段训练策略调整为FastWAM和IDM,首先独立微调视频模式,然后在训练行动政策的同时冻结其参数. 这大大改善了FastWAM和IDM在各种干扰方面的表现。 然而,即使有了这一培训战略,在各种扰动类别中(见表7),我们发现FastWAM的概括性表现明显低于IDM。 此外,我们考虑Porce变体的简化1-Step,该变体在训练期间独立地抽样z 1 → p prefore z_{1}\sim p_{\mathrm{poror},而不是使用与所显示的未来相关的噪声端点,同时使用相同的第1阶段视频主干线.

blocks.en: B.2 Performance on LIBERO-PRO.
blocks.zh: B.2 利伯罗-PRO的性能。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 7 , FastWAM generalizes worse than IDM across all perturbation categories. In particular, there is a significant gap under object-size perturbations on LIBERO-Goal, where IDM achieves 60.8% compared to 44.4% for FastWAM (Table 8 ); detailed task-level results are provided in Table 9 . When the grasped object is enlarged, IDM’s imagined future correctly captures the gripper interacting with the larger object, while FastWAM’s action chunk does not appear to appropriately account for the increase in object size. This suggests that future-predictive information provides geometric cues important for generalization under distribution shift.
blocks.zh: 如表7所示,FastWAM在所有扰动类别中概括比IDM更坏. 特别是,在LIBERO-目标物体大小扰动下存在很大差距,IDM达到60.8%,FastWAM则为44.4%(表8);详细的任务级结果见表9。 当被抓住的对象被扩大时,IDM所想象的未来会正确地捕捉到与较大对象相互作用的钳子,而FastWAM的动作块似乎并没有适当地反映对象大小的增加. 这表明,未来预测信息提供了几何提示,对于在分配转移时的概括很重要。

blocks.en: Table 7 : Performance under LIBERO-PRO perturbations. Models are trained on LIBERO and evaluated under perturbations to object attributes (Obj.), initial object positions (Pos.), instruction phrasing while preserving task intent (Sem.), and instructions specifying a different target object or action (Task); None denotes the unperturbed setting. joint denotes joint training of the video model and action policy, whereas disj denotes the two-stage training procedure.
blocks.zh: 表7:在LIBERO-PRO干扰下的表现。 模型在LIBERO上接受训练,并在扰动下评价对象属性(Obj.),初始对象位置(Pos.),指令在保留任务意图(Sem.)的同时措辞,以及指定不同目标对象或动作(任务)的指令;无一表示未扰动的设置. 联合表示联合培训录像模式和行动政策,而disj表示两阶段培训程序。

blocks.en: Furthermore, FastWAM and several IDM variants jointly train the action expert and video model, allowing the action loss to backpropagate through the video model. Fine-tuning a pretrained video model in this manner may degrade its generalization, particularly when the action-training data are narrowly distributed. To investigate this hypothesis, we decouple the two training stages: we first fine-tune the video model independently, freeze its parameters, and then train the action expert using the action loss. We apply this disjoint training procedure to both FastWAM and IDM, denoted FastWAM (disj) and IDM (disj), respectively, with results reported in Table 7 .
blocks.zh: 此外,FastWAM和几个IDM变体联合培训动作专家和视频模型,使得动作损失能够通过视频模型进行后置. 以这种方式对预先训练好的视频模型进行精细调整可能会降低其通俗化程度,特别是在动作训练数据分布狭窄的情况下。 为了调查这个假设,我们解开两个训练阶段:我们首先独立地微调视频模型,冻结其参数,然后用动作损失来训练动作专家. 我们对FastWAM和IDM适用这种脱节培训程序,分别表示FastWAM(磁盘)和IDM(磁盘),结果见表7。

blocks.en: Disjoint training yields substantial gains under initial-state perturbations, improving IDM from 2.7% to 10.9% and FastWAM from 0.9% to 10.5%, while also improving performance under the other perturbation categories. Qualitative analysis of the predicted videos indicates that these gains stem from more accurate future predictions, particularly for initial-state perturbations, where the jointly trained IDM video model tends to overfit to the training-time initial object positions. FastWAM also benefits substantially under object-size and language perturbations, improving from 83.7% to 94.7% under language perturbations and from 44.4% to 53.6% on LIBERO-Goal object-resize perturbations (Table 8 ).
blocks.zh: 联合培训在初始状态扰动下产生很大收益,将IDM从2.7%提高到10.9%,FastWAM从0.9%提高到10.5%,同时在其他扰动类别下也提高了性能. 对预测视频的质量分析表明,这些收益来自更准确的未来预测,特别是对初始状态扰动的预测,在初始状态扰动中,联合培训的IDM视频模型往往过于适合培训时间初始物体位置. FastWAM在物体大小和语言扰动下也受益匪浅,在语言扰动下从83.7%提高到94.7%,在LIBERO-目标大小扰动上从44.4%提高到53.6%(表8)。

blocks.en: To better understand why joint training hurts IDM, we examine the role of future-observation augmentation during action training. In the standard joint setting, the future observations provided to the action expert are randomly noised to a sampled noise level with probability 0.5 0.5 . When we remove this augmentation ( p = 0 p=0 ) and always provide clean futures, joint IDM recovers performance comparable to disjoint training across perturbations (Table 7 ). This suggests that, when clean futures are available, the action expert can fit the action objective with substantially less modification to the shared video-model representations, thereby better preserving the generalization inherited from pretraining despite action-loss backpropagation.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地理解联合培训为何会伤害到信息、数据和管理部,我们审查了未来观察在行动培训期间增强的作用。 在标准联合设定中,向行动专家提供的未来观测结果随机发出噪声,为抽样噪声水平,概率为0.5 0.5. 当我们去除这种增强(p = 0 p = 0)并且总是提供干净的未来时,联合IDM恢复了相当于跨扰动的脱节训练的性能(表7). 这表明,在有清洁期货的情况下,行动专家可以适应行动目标,对共享的视频模型表示的修改要少得多,从而更好地保持从预训中继承的概括性,尽管行动损失反射。

blocks.en: This also helps explain why FastWAM continues to benefit from disjoint training on LIBERO. Without future-derived conditioning, its action expert must infer the action sequence from the current observation and instruction alone. Optimizing the action objective therefore places greater pressure on the shared video-model representations, making them more susceptible to specialization to LIBERO’s relatively narrow action-training distribution. Freezing the video model prevents this adaptation and preserves more of its pretrained generalization, leading to the stronger robustness observed for FastWAM (disj).
blocks.zh: 这也有助于解释为什么FastWAM继续受益于关于LIBERO的脱节培训. 没有未来的条件,其行动专家必须仅从目前的观察和指示中推断行动顺序。 因此,优化行动目标给共享的视频模型展示带来更大的压力,使它们更容易被专门化到LIBERO相对狭窄的动作训练发行中. 冷冻视频模型阻止了这种适应,并保留了更多其经过预先训练的概括,导致观察到的FastWAM(Disj)更强健.

blocks.zh: 附录C DROID 实验设置

blocks.en: C.1 Training Details
blocks.zh: C.1 培训细节

blocks.en: We train on DROID [ 13 ] using the DreamZero release [ 35 ] , which removes idle frames and unlabeled or unsuccessful episodes, yielding 57,774 episodes and 14.7M frames at 15 Hz. Each training example consists of the current observation, a 32-step action chunk ( ≈ \approx 2.1 s), and the corresponding future video. We subsample the future by 2 × 2\times in time to obtain 16 future frames; together with the current frame, this gives 17 frames, which the Wan2.2 VAE compresses into 5 latent frames. We use the wrist and first exterior camera, resize each view to 160 × 320 160\times 320 , and concatenate them side by side before VAE encoding. Actions contain seven joint-position targets, expressed as deltas relative to the current joint state, and one absolute gripper command. We normalize actions to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] using the 1st and 99th percentiles, with separate statistics for each action dimension and each of the 32 positions within the chunk. Proprioception consists of the current seven joint positions and gripper state and is provided only to the action expert; the video model receives no proprioceptive input. We apply temporally consistent color jitter following DreamZero [ 35 ] , sample one language annotation per episode when multiple are available, and precompute instruction embeddings using the frozen UMT5 encoder from Wan2.2.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 DreamZero 发布 [35] 在 DROID [13] 上进行训练,该发布会删除闲置的帧和无标签或未成功的事件,在 15 Hz 上产生57 774 集和14 7M 帧。 每个培训实例包括当前观察、 32 步动作块( \\\ 大约 2.1 s) 以及相应的未来视频。 我们以2×2\的时速将未来做为样本,以获得16个未来帧;与目前的帧一起,这给出了17个帧,Wan2.2 VAE将其压缩为5个潜在帧. 我们使用手腕和第一台外置相机,将每个视图的大小调整为160×320 160\times 320,并在VAE编码前将它们并排. 动作包含七个联合位置目标,以相对于当前联合状态的三角洲表示,和一个绝对抓取命令. 我们把行动正常化为[− 1, 1][-1, 1],使用第1和第99百分位数,对每个行动方面和在块内的32个位置分别进行统计。 Proprioception由目前的7个联合位置和抓取状态组成,并且只提供给动作专家;视频模型没有获得自動输入. 我们在DreamZero [35] 之后使用时间上一致的颜色焦虑,在有多种可用时每集抽取一种语言注释,并使用Wan2.2的冷冻UMT5编码器预先计算指令嵌入.

blocks.en: We initialize the video model from Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, keeping the VAE and text encoder frozen. Training proceeds in two stages. In Stage 1, we fine-tune the full video DiT for 100K steps with a global batch size of 256 ( ∼ \sim 1.7 epochs) using the bidirectional shortcut objective described in Section 5 , together with Guidance-Free Training [ 4 ] . We use a maximum number of sampling steps K max = 32 K_{\max}=32 for the shortcut training objective, sample the inverse-guidance parameter β ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) \beta\sim\mathcal{U}(0,1) , and apply 10% conditioning dropout. Three quarters of each batch use the standard flow-matching loss, while the remaining quarter uses the Shortcut bootstrap loss, with noise-to-clean and clean-to-noise transport sampled equally. Bootstrap targets are constructed from two half-steps using a Polyak-EMA target network with update rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} . We additionally apply a round-trip consistency loss to one eighth of each batch, with its weight warmed up to 0.2 following the bidirectional training principle of Bidirectional Consistency Models [ 16 ] . Flow times are sampled using the shifted Wan2.2 schedule with shift factor 5, which biases training toward higher-noise flow times. When initialized without GFT, shortcut-style training incurs only about 16% additional cost over an equivalent flow model [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们从Wan2.2-TI2V-5B开始初始化视频模型,保持VAE和文本编码器的冻结. 培训分两个阶段进行。 在第一阶段,我们利用第5节描述的双向捷径目标,以及无指导培训[4],对100K步骤的完整视频DiT进行微调,全球批量大小为256(\\sim 1.7 epocts). 我们使用最大采样步骤 K max = 32 KQQmax QQ 32 来进行快捷训练目标, 抽样反导参数 β QU Q( 0, 1)\ beta\sim\ mathcal{U} (0, 1) , 并应用10%的调试退出 。 每批中有四分之三采用标准流量比对损失,其余四分之一采用捷径靴套损失,噪声到清洁和清洁到噪声的运输抽样相同。 botstrap目标由两个半步构成,使用Polyak-EMA目标网络,更新率为10 - 3 10 - 3 - 3}。 此外,我们还对每批的八分之一实行双向一致性损失,其重量按照双向一致性模式的双向培训原则加热至0.2。 流动时间的抽样采用改变的Wan2.2时间表,其中的值班系数5使培训倾向于高噪音流动时间。 在没有GFT的初始化时,快捷方式的培训仅比等量的流量模式增加约16%的费用[7].

blocks.en: In Stage 2, we initialize the frozen video model from the Stage 1 EMA weights and train a freshly initialized action policy for 100K steps with a batch size of 256. Unlike Stage 1, we do not use a shifted flow-time schedule for action training; instead, flow times are sampled uniformly from [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . For i WAM , we recover the noise endpoint of each demonstrated future using two clean-to-noise flow-map steps at guidance strength w = 7 w=7 . The subsequent noise-to-clean evaluation that conditions the action policy uses the same guidance strength, both during training and at inference. The action policy uses 30 transformer layers, hidden dimension d a = 1024 d_{a}=1024 , and FFN dimension 4096, totaling approximately 1B trainable parameters. Since the learned flow map also serves as a standard flow model, we reuse the same trained video model for both i WAM and IDM to ensure a controlled comparison. For both methods, we freeze the video model and train their respective action policies for 100K steps; during IDM evaluation, the shared video model is used with standard flow integration. IDM-flow map also uses the learned flow map to approximate the future in a single step during evaluation.
blocks.zh: 在第2阶段,我们从第1阶段EMA权重中初始化冷冻的视频模型,并为100K级台阶培训新的初始化动作政策,批量尺寸为256. 与第一阶段不同的是,我们不使用改变的流程-时间时间表来进行行动培训;相反,流程时间是从[0, 1] [0, 1] 中统一抽取的。 对i WAM来说,我们利用导力W=7 w=7的两个清洁到噪声流图步骤来恢复每个显示的未来的噪声端点。 随后对行动政策作条件的噪音对清洁评价,在培训和推论期间使用同样的指导力量。 动作政策使用30个变压器层,隐藏维度d a = 1024 d_{a}=1024;FFN维度4096,总计约1B可列车参数. 由于学习到的流图也作为标准流模型,我们重新使用iWAM和IDM的同样训练有素的视频模型,以确保有控制的比较. 对于这两种方法,我们冻结视频模型,并培训各自的行动政策,以达到100K步;在IDM评价期间,共享视频模型与标准流集成使用. IDM-流程图也使用学到的流程图,在评价期间以单步来大致了解未来.

blocks.en: For FastWAM, we follow the same official architecture and training procedure described above, using the same data, preprocessing, action normalization, model architecture, and optimizer as i WAM . Specifically, we jointly train a separate video model and action policy for 200K steps with a global batch size of 256, as increasing training from 100K to 200K steps slightly improves performance before saturating. FastWAM trains the video model using the standard flow-matching loss rather than the bidirectional shortcut objective used for i WAM .
blocks.zh: 对FastWAM来说,我们遵循上述相同的官方架构和培训程序,使用与iWAM相同的数据,预处理,动作正常化,模型架构,以及优化器. 具体地说,我们联合为200K步骤培训单独的视频模型和行动政策,全球批量规模为256个,因为培训从100K步增加到200K步,在饱和前会略微提高性能. FastWAM使用标准流量匹配损失而不是iWAM使用的双向快捷目标来训练视频模型.

blocks.en: The FastWAM (disj) variant was omitted from the main results because it underperformed the official jointly trained version; its task-level scores on DROID simulation are reported in Table 10 . For the two-stage training procedure of FastWAM, we use the same video checkpoint as iWAM and follow the same Stage 2 training procedure outlined above, except that the action policy conditions only on the activations of the current observation.
blocks.zh: FastWAM(Disj)变体因表现不佳而从主要结果中省略;其在DROID模拟中的任务级别分数见表10。 对于FastWAM的两阶段培训程序,我们使用与iWAM相同的视频检查点,并遵循上文概述的相同的第二阶段培训程序,只是行动政策条件只针对当前观察的启动.

Success rates (%) are measured over 20 trials per task at replanning horizons of 16 and 24 action steps. The average is computed across all task–horizon combinations.

blocks.en: All flow-based action policies are trained with the flow-matching formulation. We additionally train an i WAM variant using the Minimal Iterative Policy (MIP) objective [ 27 ] , which predicts actions in two denoising steps: an initial regression step followed by refinement; we denote this variant as i WAM (MIP). We also evaluated a two-stage FastWAM variant, but it underperformed the jointly trained version and is therefore omitted from the main results.
blocks.zh: 所有基于流动的行动政策都经过了与流动匹配的制定培训。 此外,我们还利用最小迭代政策(MIP)目标[27]来培训i WAM变体,该变体在两个去诺步骤中预测行动:一个初始回归步骤,然后是完善;我们表示这一变体为i WAM(MIP)。 我们还评价了一个两阶段的FastWAM变体,但它的表现低于联合训练的版本,因此在主要结果中被省略.

blocks.en: Both stages use AdamW with ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.95) , ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8} , weight decay 10 − 5 10^{-5} , gradient clipping at norm 1.0, and a global batch size of 256. For Stage 1 bidirectional Shortcut training, the learning rate is linearly warmed up for 5K steps to 10 − 5 10^{-5} and then kept constant. For Stage 2, the learning rate warms up for 5K steps to 10 − 4 10^{-4} and then follows cosine decay to 10 − 6 10^{-6} . Unless otherwise noted, Stage 2 models are trained for 100K steps; the FastWAM baseline is trained for 200K steps with the cosine schedule extended accordingly. Training uses bfloat16 computation with fp32 master weights and optimizer states.

We report the MSE between the decoded reconstruction and the VAE-decoded ground truth, averaged over future-frame RGB pixels and all samples, excluding the current observation. Both videos are in the [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] RGB range when computing the MSE.

Pixel-level MSE is only a coarse proxy, since it also reflects differences in visual content between the two datasets. Nevertheless, the size of the gap is consistent with LIBERO’s more constrained task and demonstration distribution making randomly sampled futures more consistent with the demonstrations, which leaves limited additional benefit from inversion.

blocks.en: C.3 Joint vs. Disjoint Training Across LIBERO and DROID
blocks.zh: C.3 联合培训与跨利比里亚和德国联合培训

blocks.en: As shown in Table 10 , FastWAM (disj) achieves an average success rate of 1.7%, compared to 9.2% for jointly trained FastWAM. This contrasts with LIBERO, where disjoint training substantially improves FastWAM’s robustness under perturbations (Table 7 ). We hypothesize that this reversal reflects DROID’s substantially greater diversity of demonstrated futures compared to LIBERO. Since FastWAM does not condition on a specific future, in particular the one realized by the supervised actions, learning to predict actions across DROID’s more diverse demonstrations may benefit more from adapting the shared video-model representations to the action objective. Joint training enables this adaptation, whereas freezing the video model restricts it and can constrain action learning. Thus, while freezing helps preserve the pretrained generalization of the video model on LIBERO’s narrower action-training distribution, the benefits of action-relevant adaptation may outweigh those of preserving these pretrained representations for FastWAM on DROID.
blocks.zh: 如表10所示,FastWAM(Disj)的平均成功率是1.7%,而联合培训的FastWAM为9.2%。 这与LIBERO形成对比,在LIBERO中,不联合培训大大改善了快速WAM在扰动下的稳健性(表7)。 我们假设,这一逆转反映了DROID与LIBERO相比,所展示的期货的多样性要大得多。 FastWAM并不取决于具体的未来,特别是监督行动实现的未来,因此,如果能够根据行动目标调整共享的视频模型表达方式,学习预测DROID更多样化的演示中的行动,可能更有好处。 联合培训使这种适应成为可能,而冻结录像模式则限制了这种适应,并可能限制动作学习。 因此,虽然冻结有助于在LIBERO范围较窄的动作训练分发上保持视频模型事先经过训练的通用性,但与行动有关的适应的好处可能超过在DROID上为FastWAM保留这些事先经过训练的表述。

blocks.en: Together with the LIBERO analysis, these findings suggest that the benefits of preserving pretrained video-model representations depend on the information available to the action expert. For IDM-style approaches that condition action prediction on a specific future, preserving pretrained predictive capabilities is particularly important. In contrast, approaches without such conditioning, such as FastWAM, may benefit from adapting the shared representations to the action objective, particularly on more diverse demonstration distributions. More broadly, these results underscore the importance of exposing the action expert to future-predictive information at test time for robust generalization.
blocks.zh: 与LIBERO分析一起,这些调查结果表明,保留经过预先培训的视频模型表述的好处取决于行动专家可获得的信息。 对于将行动预测作为特定未来条件的IDM式方法,保留预先训练的预测能力特别重要。 与此相反,不设这种条件的办法,如FastWAM,可能得益于使共同表述符合行动目标,特别是关于更加多样化的示范分布。 更广义地说,这些结果突出表明,必须让行动专家在试验时了解未来的预测信息,以便进行有力的概括。

blocks.en: C.4 Benchmark Initialization
blocks.zh: C.4 基准初始化

blocks.en: For DROID, we benchmark against IDM trained using the two-stage procedure, which uses 8 flow-denoising steps at inference to generate the future, requiring 9 video-backbone forward passes in total. We also evaluate a variant that uses the flow map learned by i WAM to approximate the future in a single step, which we denote as IDM-flow map , reducing action prediction to 2 video-backbone forward passes. For FastWAM, we train both joint and two-stage variants, but omit the latter from the main results due to its relatively low performance. For both simulation and real-world evaluations, we use a guidance strength of w = 7 w=7 for i WAM and both IDM variants; FastWAM does not have a corresponding guidance-strength parameter at inference. All flow-matching action policies use 8 action-denoising steps, and iWAM (MIP) uses 2 action-denoising steps. For simulation experiments, we additionally evaluate the official DROID-finetuned π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} checkpoint using its default 10-step action-denoising procedure.
blocks.zh: 就DROID而言,我们以使用两阶段程序培训的IDM为基准,该程序使用8个流向识别步骤推断产生未来,总共需要9个视频背骨前传通行证。 我们还评估一个变体,利用iWAM所学的流图,以单步来大致未来,我们表示为IDM流图,将动作预测减少到2个视频背骨前传. 对于FastWAM,我们同时训练联合式和两阶段式的变体,但由于其性能相对较低,因此在主要结果中略去后者. 对于模拟和现实世界的评价,我们对i WAM和IDM两个变体都使用w=7 w=7的制导强度;FastWAM在推论上没有相应的制导强度参数. 所有流量匹配动作政策都使用8个动作识别步骤,iWAM(MIP)则使用2个动作识别步骤. 对于模拟实验,我们额外评价了官方的DROID-finetunted π 0.5\pi_{0.5}检查点使用其默认的十步动作识别程序.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Initial configurations for real-world evaluation. The block-placement task starts with three blocks and a bowl on the table (top left). The pen-transfer task varies the cup placement and surrounding distractors (top right), while the towel-folding task varies the towel’s fold state and orientation (bottom).
blocks.zh: 图7:实时评价的初步配置。 区块布置任务从三个区块开始,桌上有一个碗(左上). 笔形传输任务会改变杯子的放置和周围的分散器(右上),而毛巾的覆盖任务则会改变毛巾的折叠状态和方向(下).

blocks.en: C.5 Evaluation Setup
blocks.zh: C.5 评价设置

blocks.en: We evaluate DROID-trained policies in both simulation and the real world. For simulation, we use the DROID benchmark [ 12 ] , implemented in Isaac Lab [ 24 ] on top of NVIDIA Isaac Sim [ 26 ] , and evaluate three pick-and-place tasks: “put the cube in the bowl,” “put the can in the mug,” and “put banana in the bin.” Each rollout lasts 30 s (450 control steps), and we evaluate replanning horizons of 16 and 24 action steps with 20 trials per task and horizon and results are reported in Table 6 . All methods that we train use an action chunk size of 32. For π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , we instead use the official DROID-finetuned checkpoint with its native action chunk size of 15 during simulation evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价在模拟和实际世界中经过DROID培训的政策。 在模拟中,我们使用在NVIDIA Isaac Sim之上的Isaaac Lab[24] 实施的DROID基准[12],并评价三项选址任务:“把立方体放进碗里”、“把罐子放进杯子里”和“把香蕉放进桶里”。 每次推出的时间为30s(450个控制步骤),我们评价16和24个行动步骤的重新规划范围,每个任务和范围进行20次试验,结果见表6。 我们训练的所有方法 都使用32块的动作 对于 0. 5\pi 0. 5} 我们使用官方的 DROID 过滤检查站,

blocks.en:
For real-world evaluation, we consider three manipulation tasks: placing all three blocks into a bowl,
picking a pen from the cup and placing it onto a table, and folding a towel. We fix the replanning horizon to 16 action steps and conduct 20 trials per task. Each trajectory is terminated after at most 750 control steps, i.e. 50 s of executed actions at 15 15 Hz; time
spent waiting for inference is not counted towards this budget.
blocks.zh:
对于现实世界的评价,我们考虑三个操纵任务: 把所有三个街区都放在一个碗里,
从杯子里挑一支笔,放在桌子上,然后折叠毛巾。 我们把重新规划的视野定在16个行动步骤上,并进行20次审判。 每个轨迹在最多750个控制步骤后终止,即在15赫兹时执行的50次行动;时间
等待推断的开支不计入本预算。

blocks.en: Place All Blocks in Bowl. Three blocks are placed on the table together with a bowl (Figure 7 , top left), and the instruction is “put all the blocks in the bowl.” A rollout is considered successful if all three blocks are placed in the bowl. We additionally report partial completion rates corresponding to placing at least one, at least two, or all three blocks.
blocks.zh: 把所有块都放到碗里 有三个街区与一个碗一起放在桌子上(图7,左上方),指示是“把所有街区都放进碗里”。 如果把三个街区都放在碗里,那么推出就被认为是成功的。 我们还报告部分完成率,即至少设置一个、至少两个或全部三个区块。

blocks.en: Pick Pen from Cup and Place on Table. A pen is initially placed inside a cup, and the instruction is “take the pen from the cup and place it on the table.” We evaluate four initial configurations that vary the cup placement and the arrangement of distractor objects, including one configuration without distractors (Figure 7 , top right), with five rollouts per configuration for a total of 20 trials. A rollout is considered successful if the policy removes the pen from the cup and places it on the table.
blocks.zh: 从Cup和Place桌上选笔。 一支笔最初放在杯子里,指示是“从杯子里拿起笔放在桌上”。 我们评价四种初始配置,这些配置改变了杯子的放置和分散对象的安排,包括一种配置没有分散对象(图7,右上方),每个配置有五次推出,总共20次试验. 如果政策将钢笔从杯子上除去并放在桌上,则推出被认为是成功的。

blocks.en: Fold Towel. A towel is initially laid flat on the table, and the instruction is “fold the towel.” We evaluate four initial configurations that vary the towel’s fold state and orientation: folded in half widthwise, folded widthwise with a rotated orientation, folded in half lengthwise, and fully spread out (Figure 7 , bottom). A rollout is considered successful if the robot lifts and folds the towel such that, in total, approximately 40% or more of the initially exposed towel area is flipped onto the opposite side.
blocks.zh: 叠毛巾. 毛巾最初放在桌子上平铺,指示是“双层毛巾”。 我们评价四个改变毛巾折叠状态和方向的初始配置:折叠为半宽方向,折叠为宽方向,折叠为半长方向,并完全分布(图7,下方). 如果机器人抬起和折叠毛巾,从而将大约40%或40%以上的最初暴露毛巾区域翻到相反的一侧,则推出被认为是成功的。

blocks.en: C.6 Qualitative Rollouts and Failure Modes
blocks.zh: C.6 定性推出和失败模式

blocks.en: Figures C.6 and C.6 illustrate the behavioral differences between i WAM and FastWAM across the six DROID evaluation tasks, following the task order in Tables 6 and 5 . While i WAM successfully completes the instructed manipulation tasks, FastWAM either makes partial progress without completing the task or exhibits poor instruction following. These differences appear in both simulation and real-world evaluations: grasping an object does not always lead to a completed placement, and an unsuccessful attempt can be followed by interactions with unrelated objects rather than a retry of the intended manipulation.
blocks.zh: 图C.6和C.6说明i WAM和FastWAM在六个DROID评价任务中的行为差异,按照表6和表5中的任务顺序排列. 虽然i WAM成功完成指令性操作任务,但FastWAM要么在未完成任务的情况下取得部分进展,要么在完成后显示指令差. 这些差异出现在模拟和现实世界的评价中:抓住一个物体并不总是导致一个完成的放置,一次不成功的尝试之后可以与无关物体进行互动,而不是对意图的操纵进行重试.

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Simulation evaluation behaviors. i WAM maintains its grasp while carrying the cube into the bowl, whereas FastWAM repeatedly loses its grasp. On the can-placement task, i WAM lifts the can into the mug, while FastWAM reaches into the mug without grasping the can. On the banana-placement task, i WAM lifts the banana high enough to clear the bin wall before lowering it inside; FastWAM fails to clear the wall, drops the banana outside, and subsequently tips over the empty bin.
blocks.zh: 图8:模拟评价行为. i WAM在将立方体抬进碗中时保持其抓力,而FastWAM则反复失去抓力. 在罐头布置任务上,我WAM将罐头抬进杯子,而FastWAM则伸进杯子而不抓住罐头. 在香蕉布置任务上,iWAM将香蕉抬高到足够清场的垃圾桶壁后再将其内降;FastWAM未能清理墙体,将香蕉扔到外面,随后在空箱上方提示.

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Real-world evaluation behaviors. i WAM places all three blocks in the bowl in succession, whereas FastWAM stops after placing two. On the pen-transfer task, i WAM grasps the pen and lifts it out of the cup before placing it on the table; FastWAM instead grasps the cup and knocks the pen out. On the towel-folding task, i WAM grasps and lifts the towel edge to fold it over, while FastWAM overshoots the edge and moves away without grasping it.
blocks.zh: 图9:现实世界评价行为. i WAM将所有三个街区都连续放在碗中,而FastWAM在放置两个后停止. 在笔调任务上,iWAM抓住笔,将笔从杯中提出,然后放在桌上;FastWAM则抓住杯子,敲倒笔. 在毛巾覆盖的任务上,iWAM抓住并提升毛巾边缘来折叠它,而FastWAM则过度射击边缘并移动而不抓住它.

blocks.en: FastWAM failure modes. Figure 10 illustrates two forms of instruction-following failure on the pen-transfer task. FastWAM can disregard the instruction from the outset, manipulating unrelated objects without attempting the instructed task. Alternatively, it initially follows the instruction but deviates after a missed grasp, switching to unrelated objects rather than retrying the intended manipulation.
blocks.zh: FastWAM 失败模式. 图10显示在笔汇转移任务失败之后的两种指导形式。 FastWAM可以从一开始就无视指令,在不尝试指示任务的情况下操纵不相关的对象. 或者,它最初遵循指令,但在失去抓住后偏离,切换到不相关的对象,而不是重试预期的操纵.

blocks.en: Figure 10 : FastWAM instruction-following failures on the pen-transfer task. FastWAM manipulates unrelated objects from the outset (a), or abandons the target object after a missed grasp rather than retrying the intended manipulation (b).
blocks.zh: 图10: FastWAM 指令跟踪笔迹传输任务的失败. FastWAM从开始(a)操纵不相关的对象,或者在丢失的抓取后放弃目标对象,而不是重试预定的操纵(b).
